g.text: data/reported_emissions.csv holds figures read by hand from each company's own primary document (annual
report, sustainability statement, assurance or verification statement, SASB index, CDP response or ESG data book),
one row per group, with boundary, URL, section and date checked (2026-10-20). Figures available only from
aggregators (Tracenable, DitchCarbon) or AI-extracted summaries were not used, and figures whose table could not
be read unambiguously were left out (e.g. Lyft). Where a company publishes only a combined Scope 1+2 or total
figure, Scope 1 is left blank. Rows are shown next to, never merged with, the Climate TRACE estimate.
Coverage: 79 of the 94 classified company groups, together 94.3% of the tonnes retired by classified companies.
Notable checks: "Hörmann Gruppe" reports belong to HÖRMANN Industries, not the buyer Hörmann KG, so they were
not used; Civitas Resources is now part of SM Energy; Reports from Air France-KLM, Infosys, Allianz, BAT and BCG
were read in a regular browser because those sites block scripted downloads; the CMA CGM report was read from
the copy hosted by its subsidiary CEVA Logistics because the group site link is broken. BCG publishes Scope 1 only
inside a chart without a clear label, so it was left out. The Civitas report was removed after the SM Energy merger.
OVO and BrewDog figures come from their audited accounts filed at Companies House (scanned documents, read page
by page); BrewDog labels its figures as estimates pending final calculation. Tables extracted from PDFs were checked
against the rendered page or against the report's own totals, because text extraction can shift table rows.
Greenchoice and ESWE servers could not be reached, LichtBlick's management report contains no emissions figures,
and Bonnier reports emissions only per business unit. The remaining groups (mostly energy retailers and small
private companies) publish no group-level absolute Scope 1 figure that could be found in a primary document.
Every group without a reported figure has a written reason in data/emissions_gaps.csv (what was checked,
where, when, and why no figure is shown); the site shows that reason instead of a blank. A second, targeted search
on 21 Oct 2026 found figures for three groups first listed as missing (Süwag, Friedrich Scharr, Städtische Werke
Kassel via its parent KVV), which are now included.
